user.title: Home Assistant toolkit
user.description: Connect devices managed by Home Assistant. This does not automatically expose an existing Apple Home configuration.

pairing.title: Pair with your Toolforest account
pairing.description: Open [{url}]({url}), sign in to Toolforest, and approve code **{code}**. Then submit here. The code expires after 10 minutes.

exposure.title: Select exposed entities and actions
exposure.description: Nothing is exposed by default. Select lights and switches for reads, then separately allow each action. Action selections must also be in the read selection. Other entity domains are excluded.

data.read_entities: Entities to expose for state reads
data.turn_on_entities: Exposed entities allowed to turn on
data.turn_off_entities: Exposed entities allowed to turn off
data.brightness_entities: Exposed lights allowed to change brightness

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The Toolforest device was revoked or its credential is no longer valid. Pair this Home Assistant instance again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Toolforest. Check connectivity and try again.
error.authorization_pending: Approve the code in Toolforest first, wait a few seconds, then submit again.
error.invalid_exposure: Every action target must also be selected for state reads; brightness is limited to lights.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired or was already used. Start setup again.
